quantity: S-NPP-equivalent daily fire radiative power sum estimated from Terra and Aqua MODIS
approved_claim: Harmonized series for the Pantanal, validated in an independent 2020–2026 test, with limited coverage in 2025–2026 and no independent backward test.
caveats: Limited paired coverage in 2025-2026 (28 and 13 paired days in the independent test).
No independent backward test; the post-hoc v2 backward result is descriptive evidence only.
The frozen v1 candidate failed the registered forward test; that Plan B result is preserved unchanged.
publication_scope: Only solar dates on which both Terra and Aqua are complete (day and night turns).

model.pass_alignment: Terra night turn assigned to the following solar date; all other turns keep their solar date

interpretation.interval: Nominal 80% interval from training residual ratios; coverage is not guaranteed.
interpretation.is_extrapolated: An input exceeded its stratum's training maximum; the interval is inflated.

sample_role.training_window_in_sample: The model was fitted on this window, so agreement with S-NPP here is not evidence.
sample_role.post_hoc_examined_holdout: After training, but examined before the v2 candidate was designed.
sample_role.independent_holdout: After training and never examined before the owner's registration.

interpretation.missing_dates: A date absent from the series was not acquired or lacks a complete Terra or Aqua turn; it is not zero fire activity.
interpretation.snpp_observed_frp_mw: Observed reference where both S-NPP turns exist; null otherwise.
